(2) The man continues singing, now opening his eyes and looking directly at the woman while gesturing rhythmically with his free right hand. The woman looks up from her phone, her expression shifting to one of skeptical annoyance and then shock. She points her finger accusingly towards him, her mouth open as if interjecting. Several plush toys and a small picture frame are visible on the headboard behind them. (3) The man reaches a high note, leaning his body toward the woman to emphasize the lyrics. The woman rolls her eyes upwards and rests her chin on her hand, looking weary and unimpressed. The room is brightly lit with even indoor lighting, showing an air conditioning unit mounted on the plain white wall. (4) As the song concludes with a final dramatic line, the man suddenly tumbles backward off the bed frame with a quick, jarring motion. The woman remains on the bed, looking down at where he fell with a deadpan, slightly satisfied expression before the frame cuts. The camera remains in a static medium shot throughout the sequence.
